world.title: Nepali family had begun funeral rituals for 64-year-old Chandrika Shrestha thinking she has died in the devastating floods; then she was found buried under mud but alive on the 11th day
world.summary: Chandrika Shrestha, a 64-year-old woman in Nepal, was believed dead after devastating floods from the Bhotekoshi river on August 26. Her family conducted funeral rituals, having searched for her for eight days without success. On the 11th day, she was discovered alive, partially trapped in mud on the fourth floor of a buried house.

world.title: Banking on the dollar: How Iran keeps $9bn flowing through US banks despite sanctions
world.summary: A Wall Street Journal investigation reveals that despite US sanctions, Iran is managing to transfer $9 billion through American banks. The findings indicate that the US efforts to isolate Iran from the global financial system are being undermined, as significant funds continue to flow, highlighting challenges in enforcing sanctions and the complexities of international finance.

world.title: In 2017, a 14-year-old Virginia girl dug a backyard pond for a school project; 9 years later, it has become a thriving wildlife ecosystem
world.summary: In 2017, a 14-year-old girl in Virginia created a backyard pond for a school project. Nine years later, this pond has evolved into a thriving wildlife ecosystem, showcasing the impact of small habitat projects. It provides essential resources such as food, water, shelter, and native vegetation, highlighting the importance of local initiatives in fostering biodiversity.

business.title: Top stocks in focus on Monday: Why investors should watch RVNL, Mazagon Dock, Tata Motors shares - Know news, triggers
business.summary: Indian stock market investors are expected to focus on several companies on Monday, September 7. Key stocks include Rail Vikas Nigam (RVNL), Tata Motors, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, and JSW Steel. These companies have recently announced significant business updates, new order wins, fundraising plans, and investment announcements that could influence market performance and investor interest in the upcoming trading session.

business.title: Sridhar Vembu says AI could write most software, humans must figure out how to stay relevant
business.summary: Sridhar Vembu, founder of Zoho, stated that AI has the potential to generate a significant portion of software code, prompting concerns about the future of software jobs for humans. His comments followed a viral discussion on AI's capabilities in mathematics, highlighting the need for humans to adapt and find ways to remain relevant in an increasingly automated landscape.

business.title: Banking on the dollar: How Iran keeps $9bn flowing through US banks despite sanctions
business.summary: A Wall Street Journal investigation reveals that despite US sanctions, Iran continues to transfer approximately $9 billion through American banks. The US aims to isolate Iran from the global financial system, yet these funds indicate ongoing financial activity. The findings highlight challenges in enforcing sanctions and the complexities of international banking practices involving sanctioned nations.

technology.title: Why China is planning to launch a 3D satellite chain
technology.summary: China is planning to launch a three-dimensional satellite network between Earth and the moon to observe solar activity and study cosmic explosions. The project has received international backing from countries including Egypt, Indonesia, Senegal, Serbia, and Thailand. The Deep Space Exploration Laboratory stated that this constellation of satellites aims to address a global gap in systematic observation.

technology.title: Forget iPhone 18 Pro Max: iPhone Ultra is said to feature ultra-thin design and MagSafe support
technology.summary: Apple is expected to introduce its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Ultra, at the September 9 launch event. The device may feature a book-style design, an A20 Pro chipset, and support for MagSafe wireless charging, all while being just 4.5mm thick when unfolded. The starting price is anticipated to be around $2,000, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series.

technology.title: iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro and more: What Apple could unveil on September 9
technology.summary: Apple is set to hold a significant event on September 9, where it is expected to unveil its 2026 iPhone lineup, including the iPhone Ultra and iPhone 18 Pro. Additionally, new Apple Watch models and AirPods are anticipated, along with major software updates. This event is viewed as one of Apple's most important in recent years.

sports.title: LIVE: F1 Italian GP updates - Leclerc crash causes red flag
sports.summary: The Italian Grand Prix at Monza experienced a red flag due to a crash involving Leclerc. As the race paused, Russell led, followed by Gasly and Verstappen in third. Colapinto secured fourth place ahead of Piastri. Both Haas drivers are in the top ten, while Bearman is positioned ahead of Ocon, and Bortoleto is currently in eleventh.

sports.title: Bangladesh sports minister wants BPL to be held every year
sports.summary: Bangladesh's sports minister, Aminul Haque, announced plans to discuss the future of the Bangladesh Premier League (BPL) with the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB). This follows the BCB's decision not to hold the tournament this year. Haque expressed a desire for the BPL to be held annually, emphasizing its importance as the country's only franchise-based T20 cricket competition.

sports.title: India vs Japan - search on for a broadcaster
sports.summary: ITW Universe is negotiating with FanCode, Sony, Star, and Zee to secure a broadcaster for the one-off cricket match between India and Japan. The Japan Cricket Association (JCA) is involved in these discussions to finalize the broadcast rights for the game scheduled on September 22 at Sano International Stadium in Tochigi Prefecture, Japan.

health.title: Do you eat dinner after 9 pm? Cardiologist explains how it may affect you, right time to eat for a healthy heart
health.summary: Dr. Sanjeev Gera, a cardiologist at Fortis Hospital, Noida, highlighted that eating dinner after 9 PM may negatively impact heart health, beyond just digestive issues. He referenced a 2023 study indicating that meal timing could influence cardiovascular well-being. Gera emphasized the importance of considering when we eat, suggesting that late dinners might pose additional risks to heart health.

health.title: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Shows Key Differences
health.summary: A large Australian study indicates that early-onset colorectal cancer (CRC) with liver-only metastases exhibits unique biological and clinical traits compared to late-onset cases. Researchers discovered significant differences in tumor biology, treatment responses, and survival rates between patients diagnosed before and after age 50. These findings may influence future treatment strategies and understanding of CRC progression in younger patients.

health.title: HbA1c is not the whole story: What doctors check to know if your diabetes is truly under control
health.summary: HbA1c levels below 7% are common treatment goals for diabetes, but individual targets can vary based on age, health conditions, and hypoglycemia risk. Two individuals may have identical HbA1c results yet experience different glucose patterns, with one showing steady levels and the other fluctuating. Therefore, doctors often consider additional glucose readings or continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data for comprehensive assessment.

science.title: Pangea Ultima: In 200 million years, Earth could have a new supercontinent, and its climate may be almost impossible for humans to survive
science.summary: Scientists predict that in 200 million years, Earth's continents may converge to form a new supercontinent, named Pangea Ultima. This landmass could lead to extreme heat and arid climates, making significant areas uninhabitable for mammals. The future climate will be influenced by tectonic shifts and solar changes, potentially creating conditions challenging for human survival.

science.title: Infrared quantum emission and its tuning from boron-nitride nanotube fluors
science.summary: Boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) are explored as platforms for tunable infrared quantum emission, crucial for quantum communication. First-principles calculations indicate that point defects in single-walled BNNTs can achieve tunable emissions from 1000 to 4000 nm by varying nanotube diameter and applying strain or electric fields. These findings suggest potential advancements in optical communication technologies, pending further experimental validation.

science.title: Peptides can be stable in concentrated sulphuric acid: study
science.summary: Researchers have discovered that certain peptides, which are short chains of amino acids, can remain stable in 98% concentrated sulphuric acid. This finding challenges previous assumptions about the stability of life’s building blocks in extreme environments. Additionally, these peptides can fold into complex three-dimensional shapes necessary for performing essential biological functions, indicating potential resilience in harsh conditions.

entertainment.title: Poonam Pandey slams Swara Bhasker’s ‘Padmaavat’ jauhar criticism as 'a very stupid thing to say': ‘Sanjay Leela Bhansali showed a film based on history'
entertainment.summary: Poonam Pandey criticized Swara Bhasker’s comments on the jauhar portrayal in 'Padmaavat,' calling them "a very stupid thing to say." Pandey defended the film, stating it is based on historical events and questioned Bhasker's right to critique it. The exchange highlights ongoing debates about the representation of historical narratives in cinema and differing perspectives among actors.

entertainment.title: ‘Pathaan hoon, goli maar do’: Sanjay Gupta says Shah Rukh Khan was 'only guy' who refused to bow to underworld threats
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta revealed that many Bollywood stars were vulnerable to underworld threats in the 1990s and 2000s. He emphasized that Shah Rukh Khan was the only actor who refused to succumb to these pressures. Gupta shared these insights during a conversation with Hussain Zaidi, highlighting the challenges faced by the film industry during that tumultuous period.

entertainment.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 3 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu and Ravi Kishan film crosses Rs 85 crore India net milestone in just three days
entertainment.summary: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has achieved significant box office success, surpassing Rs 85 crore in net collections within its first three days. The film, featuring Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu, and Ravi Kishan, continues to perform well in theaters. As it enters Day 3, the crime drama showcases strong audience interest and maintains its momentum in the competitive market.
